rows.label: Harvard University
rows.description: private university in Cambridge, Massachusetts
rows.hook: is the oldest institution of higher learning in the United States

rows.label: Cornell University
rows.description: private and statutory land-grant research university in Ithaca, New York, USA
rows.hook: was founded to teach any person any study and sits above deep gorges in the Finger Lakes

rows.label: University of Oxford
rows.description: collegiate research university in Oxford, England
rows.hook: is the oldest in the English-speaking world and fields rowers in an annual Boat Race on the Thames

rows.label: Columbia University
rows.description: private university in New York City, New York, US
rows.hook: administers the Pulitzer Prizes from its Morningside Heights campus in Manhattan

rows.label: Yale University
rows.description: private university in New Haven, Connecticut
rows.hook: is famed for secret societies such as Skull and Bones and its bulldog mascot

rows.label: University of Pennsylvania
rows.description: private research university in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, United States
rows.hook: was founded by Benjamin Franklin and houses the Wharton business school

rows.label: University of Cambridge
rows.description: collegiate public research university in Cambridge, England, United Kingdom
rows.hook: counts Newton and Darwin among its alumni and rows an annual Boat Race against Oxford

rows.label: Princeton University
rows.description: private Ivy League research university in Princeton, New Jersey, United States
rows.hook: wears orange and black, with a tiger mascot and a historic hall named Nassau

rows.label: Brown University
rows.description: private university in Providence, Rhode Island, United States
rows.hook: is known for an open curriculum that lets students design their own course of study

rows.label: Dartmouth College
rows.description: private university in Hanover, New Hampshire, US
rows.hook: inspired the film Animal House and cheers on its Big Green teams

rows.label: London School of Economics and Political Science
rows.description: public university in London, United Kingdom
rows.hook: is a specialist in the study of society and money that has trained many world leaders and Nobel laureates

rows.label: Tsinghua University
rows.description: public university in Beijing, China
rows.hook: is China's leading science and engineering school, set on a former imperial garden

rows.label: King's College London
rows.description: public research university in London, United Kingdom
rows.hook: was backed by the Duke of Wellington and absorbed the medical school where poet John Keats trained

rows.label: University of Edinburgh
rows.description: public university in Edinburgh, Scotland, United Kingdom
rows.hook: trained Arthur Conan Doyle, who modeled Sherlock Holmes on one of its surgeons

rows.label: Imperial College London
rows.description: public research university located in London, United Kingdom
rows.hook: is a science, engineering and medicine specialist in South Kensington near the Royal Albert Hall

rows.label: Durham University
rows.description: collegiate public research university in Durham, England, United Kingdom
rows.hook: sits beside a Norman cathedral and castle that are World Heritage sites, with students living in the castle

rows.label: University of Warwick
rows.description: university in Coventry, United Kingdom
rows.hook: is a modern campus school known for strong business and mathematics, built on former farmland

rows.label: Peking University
rows.description: university in Beijing, China
rows.hook: is known for scenic Weiming Lake and a water tower built to look like a pagoda

rows.label: University of Birmingham
rows.description: university in Birmingham, England, United Kingdom
rows.hook: is a red-brick pioneer topped by Old Joe, the tallest free-standing clock tower in the world

rows.label: University of Manchester
rows.description: public research university in Manchester, England, United Kingdom
rows.hook: is where Rutherford split the atom and where graphene was first isolated

rows.label: University of Glasgow
rows.description: university in Glasgow, Scotland, United Kingdom, founded in 1451
rows.hook: is a Scottish institution where economist Adam Smith studied and James Watt worked

rows.label: University of Sydney
rows.description: Australian university founded in 1850
rows.hook: is the oldest in Australia, famed for its Gothic sandstone Quadrangle and Great Hall

rows.label: University of Exeter
rows.description: public research university located in Exeter, United Kingdom
rows.hook: is a leafy hilltop campus in England's West Country, known for climate and sports science

rows.label: Monash University
rows.description: public university based in Melbourne, Australia
rows.hook: is named after a First World War general and is among the country's largest by enrolment

rows.label: University of Nottingham
rows.description: public research university in Nottingham, England
rows.hook: has a lakeside campus with a clock-towered building beside it
